summary.text: Harriet Holman is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from District 102 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
She assumed office on November 11, 2024, succeeding Democrat Joseph Jefferson Jr.

paragraphs.text: Harriet Holman was born in Mobile, Alabama.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Jackson State University and a graduate degree from Claflin University.
Holman assumed office in the South Carolina House of Representatives on November 11, 2024, and her current term ends on November 9, 2026.
The Republican primary for her seat on June 9, 2026, was canceled.
